### 0009 - 角色完成本次工作
**UTC:** 2026-10-15T08:03:36+00:00 | **北京时间:** 2026-10-15T16:03:36+08:00

**角色:** Coordinator · 统筹
**操作:** plan
**状态:** 已通过
**耗时（秒）:** 173.13160490000155

**交接摘要（原文）:**
> Read-only inspection found an existing twelve-module anvil_e1_top design, independent architecture/behavior/synthesis runners, public-interface trace scoreboard and fixed/float references. Preservation and extension are therefore preferable to rebuilding. The Phase 2 top-name discrepancy is resolved by the explicit no_operator_assumption of a zero-latency anvil_e_top wrapper. The supplied checkpoint is genuinely partial, includes vision tensors and lacks original layer-5 global PLE rows and most trained layers; the explicit no_operator_assumption uses a fully disclosed deterministic reduced mapping, never invented full-model weights. The genuine FP32 path must start from decoded BF16 rather than the existing quantized-input float path, otherwise the requested software-vs-hardware comparison would be circular or mislabeled. Numerical thresholds remain unchanged and must be measured for every official job; no proposed mapping is presumed to pass. Existing source capture and historical parent acceptance are not current acceptance. Four bounded checks retain architecture obligations while making functional, sensitivity and synthesis explicit, with 470 seconds of outer ceilings and a handoff reserve under the unchanged 600-second role limit. Advisory lessons exp-6a4baac55d8459da132c8b6a and exp-0938d18e059b241a4fdfbb2d apply to preserving local-script imports and normalizing escaped Yosys hierarchy names; the corresponding patterns already exist in the inspected sources and are not substitutes for fresh execution. Only read-only file tools were used during planning; no sources or evidence were changed and no experiments were run.

**原始记录（相对项目根目录）:** `.vulcan/engineering/call-0001/`

### 0015 - 角色完成本次工作
**UTC:** 2026-10-15T08:04:27+00:00 | **北京时间:** 2026-10-15T16:04:27+08:00

**角色:** Reviewer · 独立审查
**操作:** plan
**状态:** 已通过
**耗时（秒）:** 50.3802829549968

**交接摘要（原文）:**
> The Phase 2 plan needs one correction before admission: its executable timeouts contradict its stated execution budget. In plan.checks, all four timeout_s values are 120, while the specification requires outer limits of 70 seconds for architecture, 220 for functional, 40 for sensitivity and 140 for synthesis. In particular, functional passes --timeout-s 200 but would be terminated by the shared runtime at 120 seconds; synthesis has no reserved cleanup and receipt-finalization headroom beyond its 120-second inner allowance. This can interrupt required coverage or evidence retention even when the runner follows the specification.
> 
> Set those four check-level timeout_s values to 70, 220, 40 and 140 respectively, retaining the existing inner allowances, coverage, thresholds and 600-second role budget. Reconcile the executable check definitions with the budget paragraph; no simulation run is needed to resolve this plan-admission issue.
> 
> Otherwise, the proposed scope and independent checks address the original request: a zero-stage anvil_e_top wrapper preserves the existing interface; the deterministic reduced mapping explicitly discloses repeated layers and partial weights; the new FP32 reference starts from raw BF16 coefficients rather than quantized inputs; observed RTL words must meet both exact integer equality and the requested floating-point thresholds; and inherited regressions, negative controls and real synthesis remain mandatory. My read-only inspection of rtl/anvil_e1_top.sv, design/ARCHITECTURE.md, tests/verify.py, tests/model.py and tests/synthesis.py supports extending the existing implementation and bounded execution helper rather than replacing them. These are planned changes, not completed engineering results. No commands or experiments were run, and no files
> [Summary shortened; inspect the linked original record.]

> The prescribed numerical contract conflicts with official FP32 acceptance for the required eight-token case. All 16 freshly simulated anvil_e_top jobs matched the independent Q8.24 oracle exactly, with zero observed saturation. However, output dimensions 6, 4 and 2 exceeded the unchanged 0.002 maximum-error limit: 0.003292203, 0.003264368 and 0.004328251 respectively. Binary64 raw-weight diagnostics agreed with FP32 within 1.96e-7; changing only diagnostic epsilon from 1e-6 to the mandated 17/2^24 reproduced the discrepancy. Resolving this requires an independently reviewed contract/design decision; the verifier cannot change required epsilon, mapping, exact equality or thresholds. Saved verification changes cover raw BF16/hash/JSON validation, deterministic packing, independent FP32 inference, official RTL jobs and cycle metrics, fresh sensitivity, wrapper architecture/synthesis assertions, public-only acceptance coverage and retained attempt receipts. Python, Icarus and vvp were exercised; admitted architecture, nine-run functional regression and synthesis remain unexecuted here. The initial harness syntax failure is retained at evidence/preparation/phase2-official-first/attempt-20261015T081309563163Z/receipt.json, with its successful repair at evidence/preparation/phase2-official-repair/attempt-20261015T081334015178Z/receipt.json. The complete failing official matrix is retained at evidence/preparation/phase2-official-matrix/attempt-20261015T081502322745Z/receipt.json and its official_weights_comparison.json. Epsilon isolation is retained at evidence/preparation/phase2-epsilon-isolation/attempt-20261015T081805523129Z/receipt.json. A fresh official job passed strict numerical checks and the same scoreboard rejected exactly one mutated embedding LSB; see evidence/prepa
